wookieepedia_title: Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser carrier conversion
description: The Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser was a class of capital ship used by the Galactic Empire and Rebel Alliance, manufactured by Rendili StarDrive. They were designed during the Clone Wars to serve as second-line ships. After the Clone Wars most were sold to local defense forces or private interests, and several were eventually modified to serve as carriers.
